summary: The DOM test suite was updated to cover notification permissions through Web Platform Tests, disabled-scripting behavior for WebAssembly and import maps, source-phase WebAssembly compilation, focus changes involving IME text input, and pageload telemetry. Many tests no longer rely on arbitrary waits after tab switches because they now wait for reflow or another meaningful condition, making the suite more reliable. Platform-specific exceptions were also cleaned up for Wayland, Nightly, artifact builds, and macOS.
